# Station mechanicals: what to buy

For one station, built from `params.py` as it stands. Quantities in the
"Order" column include a few spares. `out/report.md` is regenerated by the
build and is the source of truth for sizes and counts; if you change a
parameter, check this file against it.

Prices and links were read from the shops on 2026-11-12 and will drift.
Omrook prices include 18 % GST; the other shops' prices are as listed.

Not listed because you already have them: the 2020 profile, the 32700 cells,
Board A, the
wind-vane PCB, the MLX90614 breakout, the antenna, reed switches, the solar
panel.

Subtotal **Rs 569**, plus **Rs 100 shipping**: Rs 669 in all (checked in a
real cart on 2026-11-12). Omrook is a marketplace, and this list splits
across two sellers, each charging Rs 50 surface shipping because neither
reaches the Rs 500 free-shipping line on its own:

- IndiaLocalShop (Delhi): every screw, the nyloc nuts and the bearings, Rs 248
- Omrook Industries (Bihar): magnets, SS304 nut and washer packs, profile nuts, Rs 321

The same list at OnlyScrews comes to about Rs 750 with GST before its own
shipping (free only above Rs 799), so Omrook is still the cheaper source.

Notes
- **SS202, not SS304.** Omrook's stainless screws are grade 202, which has
  less nickel and stains or spots outdoors sooner than 304, especially in
  coastal or polluted air. Almost every screw here sits inside plastic or
  under its own head, so expect cosmetic staining at worst. The nuts and
  washers are 304. If the exposed foot screws ever rust, they are a few
  rupees each to replace; OnlyScrews sells the same sizes in 304.
- **Shaft screws are fully threaded** at Omrook. That works (the README
  explains); a part-threaded one would only be slightly better. Omrook's
  part-threaded M5 x 40 is black mild steel and would rust, so skip it.
- **Magnets.** Omrook has no 6 x 3 disc, so the model now takes the 6 x 2
  (`mag_t = 2`). It is weaker. If a reed does not close reliably on the
  bench, buy 6 x 3 from
  [OnlyScrews](https://onlyscrews.in/products/6mm-x-3mm-neodymium-disc-magnets-n35-dia-6mm-thickness-3mm),
  set `mag_t = 3` and reprint only the vane rotor and the cup hub.
- **Profile nuts.** Skip them if your 2020 came with T-nuts.
- **Bearings.** Skip these if a 5 mm-bore size is already in your drawer, and
  set `brg_od` and `brg_w` to match.
- **Screen clamp changed after this order (2026-11-17).** The screen grew to
  five louvres (106 mm), so the stack now needs about 76.4 mm of screw. M3 x 80
  is not sold locally, so the model now takes **three M4 x 80 socket-head
  screws (OnlyScrews) and three M4 nuts**. The three M3 x 50 in this order are
  no longer used for the screen; one is still the rain axle.
- **Heat-set inserts** are not here: Omrook's brass inserts do not state an
  outside diameter, and the pilot holes depend on it. They are in the Quartz
  order below.

Subtotal Rs 159, below Quartz's Rs 500 free-shipping line, so expect a

different insert needs those two values changed.

## Filament (3D Master India)

| Item | Need | Each (Rs) | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| iSANMATE ASA, white, 1.75 mm, 1 kg | 2 | 899 (sale; 999 regular) | [listing](https://3dmasterindia.in/product/isanmate-asa-3d-filament-white/) |

Subtotal Rs 1,798. The listing gives 240 to 270 C nozzle, 80 to 100 C bed, and
asks for an enclosed printer and glue on the bed; your current ASA profile
(260 C) sits inside that. It does not state a density, so the mass estimate
below uses the usual 1.07 g/cm3 for ASA.

## Printed material

One full set of parts is about 700 cm3 of ASA, which is 750 g if every part
were solid. Most of these parts are thin-walled and print close to solid, so
expect 550 to 650 g for one set at 3 walls and 15 to 20 % infill.

**Buy two 1 kg spools.** One set fits on a single spool with a third left
over, but the first prints of the bearing pockets, the lid seal and the cup
hub will not all fit first time, and a failed enclosure body alone is 150 g.

Colour: white, or the lightest grey you can get, for everything. The screen,
sky pod and rain gauge need it for the measurement; the box and wind housing
simply run cooler. If you want a second colour for the rotors, the white
parts alone are about 290 g solid.

TPU: all five kinds of seal together are 3 cm3, about 4 g.
